Property.Name: ue_IsSetup
Property.Expression: CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.EventAction WHERE EventAction.EventHandlerRowPointer = RowPointer AND EventAction.ActionType = 21 AND EventAction.Description = 'ue_AIR_ReplicationTrigger' AND EventAction.Parameters LIKE 'IDO("ue_AIR_IDOReplicationRules") METHOD("ue_ReplicateRecordToExternalSystems") PARMS(-1, SUBSTITUTE("RowPointer = ''{0}''", P("RowPointer")), "' + IDOCollections + '", 1, "", "' + CASE EventName WHEN 'IdoPostItemInsert' THEN 'Insert' WHEN 'IdoPostItemUpdate' THEN 'Update' WHEN 'IdoOnItemDelete' THEN 'Delete' ELSE '' END + '", %)' ) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

Property.Name: ue_EventHandlersAreSetup
Property.Expression: CASE WHEN (( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.EventAction as action JOIN dbo.EventHandler as handler ON handler.RowPointer = action.EventHandlerRowPointer WHERE handler.EventName = 'IdoPostItemInsert' AND handler.Description = 'ue_AIR_ReplicationTrigger' AND handler.AppliesToObjects = CollectionName AND action.ActionType = 21 AND action.Parameters LIKE 'IDO("ue_AIR_IDOReplicationRules") METHOD("ue_ReplicateRecordToExternalSystems") PARMS(-1, SUBSTITUTE("RowPointer = ''{0}''", P("RowPointer")), "' + CollectionName + '", 1, "", "Insert", %)' ) = 1) AND (( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.EventAction as action JOIN dbo.EventHandler as handler ON handler.RowPointer = action.EventHandlerRowPointer WHERE handler.EventName = 'IdoPostItemUpdate' AND handler.Description = 'ue_AIR_ReplicationTrigger' AND handler.AppliesToObjects = CollectionName AND action.ActionType = 21 AND action.Parameters LIKE 'IDO("ue_AIR_IDOReplicationRules") METHOD("ue_ReplicateRecordToExternalSystems") PARMS(-1, SUBSTITUTE("RowPointer = ''{0}''", P("RowPointer")), "' + CollectionName + '", 1, "", "Update", %)' ) = 1) AND (( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.EventAction as action JOIN dbo.EventHandler as handler ON handler.RowPointer = action.EventHandlerRowPointer WHERE handler.EventName = 'IdoOnItemDelete' AND handler.Description = 'ue_AIR_ReplicationTrigger' AND handler.AppliesToObjects = CollectionName AND action.ActionType = 21 AND action.Parameters LIKE 'IDO("ue_AIR_IDOReplicationRules") METHOD("ue_ReplicateRecordToExternalSystems") PARMS(-1, SUBSTITUTE("RowPointer = ''{0}''", P("RowPointer")), "' + CollectionName + '", 1, "", "Delete", %)' ) = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

Property.Name: ue_EventHandlerSetupWasAttempted
Property.Expression: CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.EventHandler as handler WHERE handler.Description = 'ue_AIR_ReplicationTrigger' AND handler.AppliesToObjects = CollectionName ) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

Property.Name: ue_EventHandlersStatus
Property.Expression: CASE WHEN ( ue_EventHandlerSetupWasAttempted = 0 ) THEN 'Not Setup' WHEN ( ue_EventHandlersAreSetup = 1 ) THEN 'Setup' ELSE 'Broken' END

Property.Name: ue_EventHandlersStatusDetail
Property.Expression: CASE WHEN ( ue_EventHandlerSetupWasAttempted = 0 ) THEN 'Not Setup' WHEN ( ue_EventHandlersAreSetup = 0 ) THEN 'Broken' WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.EventHandler as handler WHERE handler.Description = 'ue_AIR_ReplicationTrigger' AND handler.AppliesToObjects = CollectionName AND handler.Active = 1 ) = 0 THEN 'Inactive' WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.EventHandler as handler WHERE handler.Description = 'ue_AIR_ReplicationTrigger' AND handler.AppliesToObjects = CollectionName AND ISNULL(handler.Active, 0) = 0 ) = 0 THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Partly Active' END
